query: Calculate the eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and spectral decomposition of the 3x3 matrix [[4, 1, -1], [1, 2, 1], [-1, 1, 4]].

Determine whether the vector space of 2x2 symmetric matrices is isomorphic to R^3 and construct the explicit linear isomorphism.
